q: So the Australian got ready to meet the challenge. 20 bottles of whiskey were given to him to get him going. Glp.glp...glp.... our friend finished it in 15min and (bbb....urrrrrrpppp) let a big burp go.
1993 April 16, Chrishantan Krishan, “BUMPER STICKERS”, in alt.tasteless.jokes (Usenet), archived from the original on 16 Aug 2026:
There he stopped, dipped his muzzle into the water and, as always when he was very thirsty, drank in repeated triplets. Glp glp glp. Glp, glp, glp.
